text: The Melvin Mooney Distinguished Technology Award is a professional honor given by the ACS Rubber Division. It was established in 1983 and is named in recognition of Melvin Mooney, who developed the Mooney viscometer and the Mooney-Rivlin hyperelastic law. The award includes an engraved plaque and prize money. It is presented to individuals who have demonstrated exceptional technical competence through significant and repeated contributions to rubber science and technology.
